card.title: IPhone 6 No Service Modem Firmware OK

source.title: IPhone 6 No Service Modem Firmware OK

claims.statement: iPhone 6 no service with IMEI and modem firmware present usually means two broken pads, V1 and U1, under the baseband CPU (which is not underfilled on this model).
Remove the shield and baseband CPU, jumper V1 and U1, mask, then reball and refit the original baseband CPU (it cannot be replaced).

procedure: Confirm modem firmware and IMEI present.
Remove baseband shield and baseband CPU.
Clean pads; jumper V1 and U1; UV mask.
Reball and refit the original BB CPU; test service and calls.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
